traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Table 6/7 (shorter incubation time results used as primary/canonical values) lists 10 numbered categories, but categories 8 (Milk powders, Infant formula and infant cereals 375g) and 9/10 (Cocoa and chocolate products 375g) each appear twice in the source table - once for 'shorter incubation time' and once for 'longer incubation time' protocol variants. I recorded only the shorter-incubation-time values as the canonical/primary study; the longer-incubation-time variant values for these same categories (SEalt 92.2%/93.3%/93.3%, SEref 92.8%/93.3%/93.3%, RT 93.0%/93.3%/93.3%, FPR 0.4%/0.0%/0.0% respectively) were omitted per instructions to avoid duplicate category entries. The overall 'Total (shorter incubation time)' and 'Total (longer incubation time)' rows (91.9/93.3/93.1/0.0 and 92.2/92.8/93.0/0.4) were excluded as aggregate summary rows, not individual food categories. Sub-category breakdowns (e.g., RTE, RTRH, Cured/smoked under 'RTE and RTRH') were also omitted in favor of the category-level Total rows, which represent the actual ISO 16140-2 category groupings (1-10) as printed in the report's category numbering column.
